name: smwgraphics-porky-pig-s-haunted-holiday-indoor-pool
title: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday - Indoor Pool
description:
A foreground tileset used in a few areas of the final level from Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: This tileset works best if you use it in a layer 2 level with layer 2 scrolling set to constant. It's also somewhat tricky to use properly, since there are a lot of tiles that look identical in the included map16 file that are needed to create the 3D like perspective, but it looks really cool if you get it right.
